icons.name: car
icons.heading: Car
icons.description: The car pulls away. Light: it squats back onto its rear wheel as it launches, so the nose and front wheel lift, and two air streaks peel off behind the roof; the nose comes down onto the front wheel with a hit and bounces once. Strong: it loads up first (the nose dips), then launches harder into a bigger lift with three streaks, lands with a hit and bounces twice. The car is rigid and pitches about its rear axle; the streaks are hidden at rest and gone before the end.

icons.name: fuel-pump
icons.heading: Fuel pump
icons.description: The pump dispenses fuel. Light: fuel surges down the hose and the hose and nozzle kick out, rebound and settle; a drop swells at the nozzle tip and falls, fading. Strong: two surges, each kicking the hose harder, and a drop forms and falls after each. The pump body never moves; the hose stays rigid and swings from where it leaves the pump; the drop is hidden at rest and gone before the end.

icons.name: speedometer
icons.heading: Speedometer
icons.description: The car accelerates and the speedometer reads it. Light: the needle sweeps up to the top mark, each mark it passes flares inward, it holds the reading a beat and drops back to its stop quicker than it rose. Strong: the car pulls through the gears: the needle climbs in three surges with a pause at each change, the marks flare in turn and the red-line mark flares hardest on arrival, then the needle drops back to its stop. The needle never overshoots its reading.

The block stays rigid; the marks ride with it and are gone before the end.

icons.name: car-lock
icons.heading: Car lock
icons.description: The car locks, and it answers like a key fob chirp. Light: the raised shackle swings 28 degrees shut and slams down into the padlock with a hit, the padlock jolts, and a beat later the car dips on its springs and rebounds. Strong: the shackle lifts and opens a little first, snaps shut and slams in, the padlock jolts harder, and the car answers with a double dip, chirp-chirp. The reverse pops the shackle up and swings it open with a small overshoot while the car stays still. The wheels stay planted; the shackle holds shut.

The reverse runs the glass up into the top seal with a hit and a small rebound. The door, window frame and handle never move; the glass holds open.

icons.name: trunk
icons.heading: Trunk
icons.description: The trunk opens. Light: the latch releases and the lid pops up a few degrees and catches, then the gas struts lift it to 70 degrees open; it overshoots a little and settles. Strong: the latch pops harder with a thunk through the car, the struts fling the lid 12 degrees past open, it swings back under and settles. The reverse swings the lid down and slams it shut: it bounces on the seal and the car dips on its springs. The wheels stay planted; the lid holds open.
